description: Source code for the UnitConverterPage class in a calculator UI test framework, providing methods to interact with the unit converter UI elements and ensure correct modes and units.

classes.name: UnitConverterPage
classes.description: Represents the unit converter page in the calculator UI test framework, providing methods to manipulate units, modes, and results.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears the calculator display by clicking the clear button.

methods.name: EnsureCalculatorResultTextIsZero
methods.description: Ensures the calculator result text is zero; clears if not.

methods.name: NavigateToUnitConverter
methods.description: Navigates the calculator to the unit converter mode.

methods.name: EnsureCalculatorIsCurrencyMode
methods.description: Ensures the calculator is in currency mode, navigates if necessary.

methods.name: EnsureSameUnitsAreSelected
methods.description: Ensures that Units1 and Units2 are set to the same units.

methods.name: SelectUnits1
methods.description: Selects a value in the Units1 ComboBox.

methods.name: SelectUnits2
methods.description: Selects a value in the Units2 ComboBox.
